# proxmox_lxc_resize (Resource)

Resizes an LXC mount point through `PUT /nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/resize`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_lxc_resize" "rootfs" {
  node     = "pve"
  vmid     = 101
  disk     = "rootfs"
  size     = "+2G"
  triggers = { revision = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disk` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `size` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Optional

- `digest` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
